scope: Read-only bounded GETs of two public landing pages and official static client assets as data. No provider JavaScript executed, no file/media fetched, no upload, cookies, authorization or redirect following.
redaction: The supplied user file ID, filename and complete landing links are omitted. No response body or account/bootstrap session data retained.

landingPages.finding: SPA HTML shell; no server-rendered file metadata or missing-file message. APP_NAME=turbobit.
Same SPA shell; this GET alone does not establish file availability or validate an upload.

sources.finding: generateLink(file) starts suffix from appConfig.urls.extension and joins shortDomain + / + file.id + optional name + suffix. Standard variant has no filename; with-file-name variant forces .html. The copyLink method copies generateLink output.

Configuration maps turbobit to urls.extension=.html and hitfile to empty extension. App name is window.__APP_NAME__ with fallback turbobit. Native download.gate route is /:id(\w+) + configured extension; named route is /:id(\w+)/:name(.+).html; unmatched routes use catchAll.

conclusion.confirmedDefect: The current Alcydeo turbobitResult builder omits the .html suffix required by the observed native Turbobit standard sharing link and native download.gate route.
conclusion.minimalFix: Keep validated ID and fixed HTTPS torbobit.net host; append .html. Do not accept arbitrary provider URLs or loosen response validation.
conclusion.limitation: The user reports upload success and lost-page UI. Source inspection confirms malformed link generation; SPA shells return HTTP 200 for both paths and do not independently confirm a remote upload or its contents.
